headline: Meta is letting go of employees it hired from the AI security startup Virtue AI, only four months after they joined.
score_reason: Kept at 5: Meta confirmed it, but it is a small staffing story with no numbers given.
importance_line: It affects the employees Meta hired from Virtue AI in June, and Meta says its AI safety work continues, but Semafor does not say how many people are affected or whether the three co-founders named in June are among them.
summary: Semafor reports that Meta is letting go of employees it hired in June from Virtue AI, an AI security startup, and a Meta spokesperson, Andy Stone, said the arrangement "didn't work out as planned"; Semafor says he put it down to clashing work styles. Meta says its Superintelligence Labs team is still focused on AI safety, alignment and frontier risk.
notes: Read the full Semafor article (short). Meta spokesperson on record; Virtue AI had not responded. Number of people and the co-founders' status not stated.
